description: Disables an earlier link of an event, so it shows that the link is no longer valid. The current link can't be disabled. Choosing the link again with update_event turns it back on.

event.description: The event: its id, any of its links or the full URL

link.description: The earlier link to disable, e.g. summer-party-x7k2 or its full URL

name: disable_old_link
title: Disable an earlier link
